title: רב אחא בריה דרבינא

paragraphs: Rav Acha, son of Ravina. Rashi explains he was a priest. Rav Ashi sent him seventeen zuz for redemption of the firstborn, Bekhorot 50a. “He appears to be a priest”—but Rashi expressly says so!
